cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, sign that my fence can stay on our boundary. I'll wait here while you choose your wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I suppose it can. Does that count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As the start. Write 'can stay' beside your name; I'll decide we're finished when the permission is clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever. Could we make it just today's agreement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can. Put today's date beside it. If you change your position later, bring me a dated change. This conversation gets to keep the ending we've actually given it.

reason: Let A evaluate tentative consent and adopt B dated-agreement solution while setting the procedure for later revision, preserving the neighbor finite commitment concern.
